extracted.intended_audience: BBC audiences, licence-fee payers, stakeholders, regulators and BBC staff seeking information about governance and regulatory arrangements
extracted.subtask_description: A high-level summary of the BBC's constitutional basis, funding, regulation, audit arrangements, partnership agreements and complaints processes. Intended to inform stakeholders about the frameworks and obligations that govern BBC operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Charter and Agreement
rubrics_metrics.description: The Royal Charter is the constitutional basis for the BBC
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines the BBC’s constitutional basis and overarching settlement with the state; establishes the formal legal framework under which the BBC operates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission, values and public purposes
rubrics_metrics.description: Our mission and public purposes are the foundation for everything that we do
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets the organisational mission, core values and the public purposes that guide BBC content, services and decision-making.

rubrics_metrics.name: Licence fee and funding
rubrics_metrics.description: Find out how we are funded - and how that money is spent
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes the funding model (licence fee) and provides transparency on how public funds are allocated and expended across the corporation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regulation
rubrics_metrics.description: We are regulated by Ofcom. It issues an operational framework and sets a licence which contains the regulatory conditions we are required to meet.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates the external regulatory regime: Ofcom provides the operational framework and a licence that specifies regulatory conditions and compliance obligations for the BBC.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audit arrangements
rubrics_metrics.description: The Comptroller and Auditor General, supported by the National Audit Office, is our external auditor
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains external audit oversight and accountability arrangements, naming the Comptroller and Auditor General and the National Audit Office as the BBC’s external auditors.

rubrics_metrics.name: BBC/S4C strategic agreement
rubrics_metrics.description: How we will work with S4C to deliver services for the benefit of Welsh-speaking audiences
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes the strategic partnership and operational agreement with S4C to coordinate services and content provision for Welsh-language audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complaints
rubrics_metrics.description: How to complain to the BBC and how we handle complaints
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets out the complaints process and how the BBC manages, investigates and responds to complaints from the public and stakeholders.
